notes.title: Family curse ver. 1.1
notes.content:
We welcome all fans of the horror genre!
We have released a small update of FAMILY CURSE

- Added Korean language
- Fixed detected errors
- Added several new sounds

Thank you for playing "Family Curse"

notes.title: DEMO
notes.content:
Dear friends. The game famaly curse has a demo version. Now you can go through a small excerpt of the game. If you like the game, add the game to your vishlist. I will also be happy to answer any questions in the game community.
